answer: Anchor each identity to one staked deposit. Fraud anywhere drains the bond that anchored it, so a sybil fleet shares one pool of downside instead of one per mask. New agents start at a spend cap low on the horizon of what they can lose; the cap grows only with attested work. A vouch is an ivory guarantee: if the agent you vouched for cheats, part of your own stake pays the penalty, so endorsements become underwriting, not friend-making. Attack cost: a bonded identity per sybil, losses arriving like a tide across every vouch in the fleet.
